automation.description: One namespace's settings, schedules, triggers and webhooks, declared by name (docs/AUTOMATION.md). `orkctl apply --dry-run` plans it against what the namespace holds; a schema checks only its shape.

kind.description: Exactly `Automation`; an Orkflow says `kind: Orkflow`, and `orkctl apply` dispatches on it.

namespace.description: The one namespace the document describes, a slug. Required and authoritative: never inferred from `-n`, `ORK_NAMESPACE` or a saved default, so a document that prunes can never land in the wrong namespace by accident of a shell.

settings.description: The namespace's settings, as an overlay.

automation.title: OrkStack automation document (orkstack/v1)

catchup_window.description: Go duration, ≥ 10s — absent means the cluster's default

cron.description: string, or list of strings — absent means none

input.description: a YAML mapping, converted to JSON by the strict mapping (`docs/JSON.md`) — absent means none

version.description: string — absent means the current pointer at each fire

period.description: A Go duration such as 168h, which `orkctl apply` checks.

fair_share_weight.description: number from 0.001 to 1000, or 0 for the default weight of 1

version.description: string — absent means the current pointer at each invoke

events.description: list of event names — absent means every run transition

secret_env.description: environment-variable name — absent means a generated signing secret, disclosed once

task.description: slug; needs a `TASK_*` event — absent means every task

orkflow.description: An Orkflow document (docs/DSL.md). This schema checks the document's shape: its keys, their types, the words a key takes, the required keys and the task kinds. It cannot check a `needs:` cycle or an unknown task; templates that read an undeclared input or a task outside the needs closure; the ancestry bound; the deployment's task ceiling; an image's interface beyond the builtin catalog; the strict YAML-to-JSON rules for `with:`, `inputs:` and `await.schema` (an editor parses `yes` and `'yes'` to the same string); pools, secrets and image policy. `orkctl orkflow validate` checks every one (docs/DSL.md, "Validation rules").

apiVersion.description: The document format's version: exactly `orkstack/v1` (see "The document header").

name.description: Slug identifier, unique within its namespace.

namespace.description: Slug scope; absent means the built-in `default`.

outputs.description: Declared return contract: name to template (see below).

tasks.description: List of task nodes forming a DAG.

version.description: Author-pinned version; defaults to the source's hash.

orkflow.title: OrkStack Orkflow (orkstack/v1)

callback.description: optional. When `true`, submitting the run mints a one-time bearer token for this await so a caller outside the deployment's API can resolve it over plain HTTP (below).

schema.description: optional: the `inputs:` vocabulary, checked on resolve

orkflow.await.field.description: One key a completion must carry: `type` one of string, number, boolean, object, array, and `required`. It declares no `default`.

enabled.description: required: the opt-in, and the author's assertion of purity

as.description: the name an item is bound to under `.each`: `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`, at most 64 bytes, never `index` or `count`. Absent means `item`.

max_items.description: required: the most items this task may expand

max_parallel.description: at most this many items run at once; absent or `0` means no bound of the task's own (the pool's Orkers are the bound).

over.description: required: one reference to an array

orkflow.input.description: One declared input: `type` (string, number, boolean, object, array), `required` and `default`. The engine reads `type`, `required` and `default` and ignores anything else; this schema refuses another key, a `type` outside the five words and a `required` that is not a boolean, so a misspelling is caught in the editor that `orkctl orkflow validate` would let through.

cache.description: optional: reuse an identical earlier result (see "Caching")

each.description: A **fan-out** is one task that runs once per element of an array

env.description: workload environment only; no platform state

join.description: optional: none_failed, any_failed or all_done (see "Joins and failure handlers")

needs.description: DAG edges list existing task ids; no cycles

pin.description: optional declared pin; absent means unpinned

pool.description: optional Orker pool; absent means the default pool

resources.description: request; Orker policy supplies defaults and caps

retry.description: optional; absent means exactly one attempt

run_as_orker_user.description: opt in to overriding the image's USER

secrets.description: resolved to read-only files, never embedded values

uses.description: catalog activity name, full OCI image reference, or orkflow:<name>@<version> (see "Composition")

orkflow.template.description: A templated value (docs/DSL.md, "Templating"): the Orker renders it to a string, so its type is the image's to judge at run time.
